WWE development level and training group NXT makes a stop in Orlando for a big night of title bouts during Halloween Havoc . In the main event, NXT Women’s Championship Kelani Jordan puts her title on the line against challenger Wren Sinclair.

Get DirecTV 5-Day Free Trial

Live from the WWE Performance Center in Orlando, Florida, NXT Halloween Havoc on Saturday, Oct. 31, with a start time of 7 p.m. ET/4 p.m. PT, on The CW. Meanwhile, there are plenty of streaming options that’ll allow you to catch all the action.

How to Watch ‘NXT Halloween Havoc’ 2026 Online, At a Glance:

- Date: Oct. 31

- Network: The CW

- Online Streaming: DirecTV , Fubo , Hulu + Live TV , ESPN Unlimited

Who’s Performing During ‘NXT Halloween Havoc’?

WWE is known for its celebrity appearances with fans in the music and entertainment industries. There have been a number of popular recording artists who made surprise appearances during NXT events, such as Billie Eilish, Corey Taylor of Slipknot, Wale, mgk and others. To find out who’s going to appear on the show, tune in to NXT Halloween Havoc .

How to Watch ‘NXT Halloween Havoc’ Online

For those with traditional cable, you can watch on The CW starting at 7 p.m. ET/4 p.m. PT. However, if you don’t have cable then the best way to watch online is with a subscription to DirecTV .

ESPN Unlimited

ESPN Unlimited is the official streaming platform for ESPN, as well as CW Sports. A subscription includes instant access for $31.99 per month. However, you can save almost 17% off by purchasing an annual subscription for $319.99 per year. It features every ESPN network, including ESPN, ESPN2, ESPNU, ESPNEWS, ESPN Deportes, SEC Network, ACC Network, ESPN on ABC, ESPN+, SEC Network+ and ACC Network Extra, as well as CW Sports — all in one streaming service.

In addition to live sports, ESPN Unlimited has original programming to stream on demand. Although the service doesn’t offer a free trial, you can still watch ESPN Unlimited with a clever workaround to watch online for free. Learn more about how to get a free trial to access ESPN Unlimited here .

On Saturday, Oct. 31, NXT Halloween Havoc , which was a former WCW annual pay-per-view event during the ’90s, is available to watch, starting at 7 p.m. ET/PT, on The CW. The best way to watch online is with DirecTV .
